name: Lesson from a process
description: Explain a verified experience and the lesson readers can transfer.
use_cases: Share a process lesson without invented personal stories
structure:
[CONTEXT]

The decision: [DECISION]

What happened: [OBSERVATION]

The lesson: [LESSON]

Optional question: [DESIRED_ACTION]
customization: Keep the story proportional to the lesson.
Use third person if the experience is not the author's.
limitations: Never fabricate first-person experience, customers, or results.
